items.title: Add manifest-based served-text verification
items.insight: The legacy text inventory excludes portfolio/ and audits/ even though the positive deployment manifest serves both. Operators cannot select manifest-complete known text without downloading binary assets.
items.evidence: Actual HTTP/CLI fixtures detect corrupted manifest-served portfolio and audit JSON, exclude unserved and binary files, honor committed configuration despite dirty worktree changes, fail closed on missing/invalid manifests, and preserve legacy text and all-served modes. Full release readback uses all-served.
